_readme: Settings for this GACC. Edit from the website's Criteria tab.
name: Northwest

Standard.description: Northwest High Risk triggers as written in the 7-Day trigger criteria. The wording gives no numbers, so the automatic Wind and Burn Environment checks start from the Southwest thresholds.

triggers.name: Wind
triggers.description: Critical wind speeds and low relative humidity resulting in an elevated chance for significant fires and the potential for significant fire growth on existing fires.

triggers.name: Lightning
triggers.description: A greater than 20% chance of significant fires due to thunderstorms.

triggers.name: Recreation
triggers.description: A greater than 20% chance of significant fires due to human activity and very dry background conditions.

triggers.name: Burn Environment
triggers.description: An elevated chance of significant fires and potential for large fire growth due to either hot temperatures, instability, and wind or a combination of these factors.
